segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the renewal and the two extra calibration modules you asked about for the Charlotte lab before I send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. Current contract ends June 30, right? We need it clean for a July 1 start, no gap on access.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, June 30 end date, July 1 renewal start. I have you at 42 named users today, and you wanted to move to 50 because of the new second shift technicians.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That is right. But only 38 need full admin rights. The other 12 just need to log gauge readings and pull certificates.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, so the quote is 38 full seats and 12 technician seats. Annual total is $64,800 before tax, net 30 billing, one invoice dated July 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And the onsite calibration workflow setup, is that included or separate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Separate line item, $4,200 one-time. That covers two remote configuration sessions, the import of your 1,180 asset records, and a one-hour training for supervisors on July 9.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our finance team asked if we can keep the same payment terms as last year. Net 30, PO required, invoice to ap@ our domain.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, same terms. I have the PO field left open on the order form, so you can send that after signature if procurement needs a day or two.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it to me and Marcus in procurement. If the numbers match what you just said, I can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send the order form this afternoon with the seat breakdown, July 1 start, and the training date noted. Anything else you want called out?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Just add that the old certificate templates stay active during the transition. We cannot have techs rebuilding those the first week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Absolutely. I’ll include that in the services notes and on the kickoff agenda so the implementation team preserves the existing templates before any changes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Thanks, yeah, send it over.
